ei.title: Instinct is the most difficult of the motivation words to define.
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Instinct is the most difficult of the motivation words to define. At the everyday level it is used often. For example, a sports commentator might say, 'He made that pass instinctively.' This means that the pass was made easily, automatically, with great skill and with a seemingly intuitive knowledge of the state of the game. However, at a technical level the word refers to behaviours that are built in, always appear in a similar form and are specific to a species. So, a spider builds a web instinctively and a bird's mating display might be instinctive. It is unlikely, though, that there is any equivalent instinctive behaviour in human beings. Some people might argue that a mother's reaction to her newly born child is instinctive, but certainly not all mothers react in the same way and even when they do, they express it in myriad forms. In general, instinct has been found to be a not very useful construct in giving accounts of the 'why' of behaviour.

❌ ③ analytical(분석적인): 겉보기에 '직관적인(intuitive)' 지식이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ common(흔한): 종에 '특정한(specific)' 행동이라는 원문과 다름

❌ ③ doubtful(의심스러운): unlikely와 비슷한 부정적 가능성
❌ ④ questionable(의문의 여지가 있는): unlikely와 비슷한 불확실성
det.tip: unlikely(가능성이 낮은) ↔ probable(있을 법한). 본문에서 인간에게 본능적 행동이 있을 가능성이 낮다는 주장이다.

questions.passage: Instinct is the most difficult of the motivation words to define. At the everyday level it is used often. For example, a sports commentator might say, 'He made that pass instinctively.' This means that the pass was made easily, automatically, with great skill and with a seemingly intuitive knowledge of the state of the game. However, at a technical level the word refers to behaviours that are built in, always appear in a similar form and are specific to a species. So, a spider builds a web instinctively and a bird's mating display might be instinctive. It is unlikely, though, that there is any equivalent instinctive behaviour in human beings. Some people might argue that a mother's reaction to her newly born child is instinctive, but certainly not all mothers react in the same way and even when they do, they express it in myriad forms. In general, instinct has been found to be a not very <u>useful</u> construct in giving accounts of the 'why' of behaviour.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 useful와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

❌ ② valuable(가치 있는): useful의 유의어

❌ ④ helpful(도움이 되는): useful의 유의어
det.tip: not very useful(그다지 유용하지 않은) ↔ worthless(가치 없는). 본능이 행동의 '왜'를 설명하는 데 유용하지 않다는 결론이다.

det.analysis:

❌ ② construct(구성개념): 이론적 개념으로 자연적 행동 경향이 아님

det.tip: instinct(본능)는 학습 없이 나타나는 타고난 행동 경향이다. 본문에서 정의하기 가장 어려운 동기 단어로 소개된다.

det.analysis: 소유격 'mother's' 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 동사 'react'를 명사 'reaction'으로 바꿔야 한다. a mother's reaction to her newly born child(어머니의 신생아에 대한 반응)에서 '소유격 + 명사' 구조이다.
det.tip: 동사 react → 명사 reaction. a mother's reaction(어머니의 반응)에서 소유격 뒤에 명사가 와야 하는 문법 구조이다.

questions.passage: For example, a sports commentator might say, 'He made that pass __________.' (instinct) This means that the pass was made easily, automatically, with great skill.

det.korean: 명사 instinct를 부사형으로 바꿔야 한다. 본능적으로라는 뜻.
det.analysis: 동사 'made'를 수식하는 부사가 필요하므로 명사 'instinct'를 부사 'instinctively'로 바꿔야 한다. He made that pass instinctively(그가 본능적으로 패스했다)에서 부사가 동사를 수식하는 구조이다.
